---
description: Phase 2 - Write failing unit/integration test cases based on approved design
---
Based on the approved design plan and requirement specifications:

1. Write test cases (unit and integration tests) covering happy paths, edge cases, and boundary conditions.
2. Ensure test setup follows our existing test runner patterns and naming conventions.
3. Confirm that all newly added tests fail as expected (TDD phase).

Do NOT implement the feature logic yet—only create or update the test suite.
